text: The major is designed to train professionals with sound scientific knowledge, basic theory and technology of the information security, basic knowledge of computer, computer skill, network security and information systems design, security management capabilities, as well as network and information security in hardware and software product development and maintenance, in government, national defense, public safety, IT enterprises and other departments and enterprises. The major is facilitated with good teaching conditions and excellent teachers. It is closely linked with communications, showing obvious development advantages and greater market demand. It is to train technology-based talents, as well as research-oriented personnel mainly in the field of network management and network security management. It pays attention to individualized training methods by fully exploiting the learning potential of students and encouraging students to learn with enthusiasm.
